gaps.sentence: The ___ (POPULAR) of the band grew after the film.
The festival celebrates ___ (CREATE) in every form.
gaps.explanation: 'Celebrates creativity' — the abstract quality noun follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: The ___ of the new bridge will take two years (CONSTRUCT).
gaps.hint: noun needed as subject of the sentence
gaps.explanation: The subject needs a noun: construction (the -tion noun); 'constructive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ to book tickets in advance during the festival (ADVICE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -able forms the adjective: advisable means worth recommending. 'It is + adjective + to-infinitive'.

gaps.sentence: Her kindness and ___ (GENEROUS) made her very popular.
gaps.explanation: Parallel to 'kindness', a noun is needed: generosity (note the irregular -osity spelling).

gaps.sentence: The audience found the lecture extremely ___ (BORE).
gaps.explanation: The lecture causes boredom, so it is boring; the audience would be bored.
After 'complete' a noun is needed: darkness (-ness noun of 'dark').

gaps.sentence: The report highlighted the ___ of sport in schools (IMPORTANT).
gaps.explanation: After 'the' a noun is needed: importance (-ance).
